12	SERVICE="${SERVICE%.service}"

14	LOCK_FILE="${lunarwing_watchdog_lock:-${LUNARWING_WATCHDOG_LOCK:-${IRONCLAW_WATCHDOG_LOCK:-/run/lunarwing-watchdog.lock}}}"
15	POST_RESTART_SLEEP_SECONDS="${lunarwing_watchdog_post_restart_sleep_seconds:-${LUNARWING_WATCHDOG_POST_RESTART_SLEEP_SECONDS:-${IRONCLAW_WATCHDOG_POST_RESTART_SLEEP_SECONDS:-5}}}"

17	timestamp() {
18	  date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'
19	}

21	prepare_log_file() {
22	  local log_dir
23	  log_dir="$(dirname -- "$LOG_FILE")"
24	
25	  if [[ -d "$log_dir" && -w "$log_dir" ]]; then
26	    touch "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || LOG_FILE=""
27	  else
28	    LOG_FILE=""
29	  fi
30	}

32	log() {
33	  local line
34	  line="$(timestamp) $*"
35	
36	  if [[ -n "$LOG_FILE" ]]; then
37	    printf '%s\n' "$line" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
38	  else
39	    printf '%s\n' "$line"
40	  fi
41	}

43	state_summary() {
44	  rc-service "$SERVICE" status 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/[[:space:]]*$//'
45	}
46	
47	prepare_log_file
48	
49	if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
50	  if exec 9>"$LOCK_FILE"; then
51	    if ! flock -n 9; then
52	      log "another watchdog run is already active; exiting"
53	      exit 0
54	    fi
55	  else
56	    log "lock file unavailable at $LOCK_FILE; continuing without lock"
57	  fi
58	fi

61	  log "$SERVICE active; no action"
62	  exit 0
63	fi

67

77	  after_state="$(state_summary || true)"
78	  log "$SERVICE start succeeded; after_state=\"$after_state\""
79	  exit 0
80	fi
81	
82	after_state="$(state_summary || true)"
83	log "$SERVICE start attempted but service is still not active; after_state=\"$after_state\""

2	set -euo pipefail
3	
4	if [[ "${EUID}" -ne 0 ]]; then
5	  echo "Run with sudo: sudo scripts/install-lunarwing-watchdog.sh" >&2
6	  exit 1
7	fi

9	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
10	REPO_ROOT="$(cd -- "${SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"
11	WATCHDOG_LOG="/var/log/lunarwing-watchdog.log"
12	SYSTEMD_UNIT_DIR="/etc/systemd/system"
13	OPENRC_CONFD="/etc/conf.d/lunarwing-watchdog"
14	OPENRC_WRAPPER="/usr/local/sbin/lunarwing-watchdog-openrc"
15	SYSTEMD_WRAPPER="/usr/local/sbin/lunarwing-watchdog"
16	FCRON_MARKER_BEGIN="# BEGIN lunarwing-watchdog managed block"
17	FCRON_MARKER_END="# END lunarwing-watchdog managed block"
18	LEGACY_FCRON_MARKER_BEGIN="# BEGIN ironclaw-watchdog managed block"
19	LEGACY_FCRON_MARKER_END="# END ironclaw-watchdog managed block"
20	
21	say() {
22	  printf '%s\n' "$*"
23	}
24	
25	die() {
26	  printf 'error: %s\n' "$*" >&2
27	  exit 1
28	}

30	binary_exists() {
31	  command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1
32	}

34	detect_service_manager() {
35	  local override="${LUNARWING_SERVICE_MANAGER:-${IRONCLAW_SERVICE_MANAGER:-}}"
36	  if [[ -n "$override" ]]; then
37	    case "${override,,}" in
38	      systemd|systemd-user)
39	        printf 'systemd'
40	        return 0
41	        ;;
42	      openrc)
43	        printf 'openrc'
44	        return 0
45	        ;;
46	      *)
47	        die "unsupported service manager override '$override'; use systemd or openrc"
48	        ;;
49	    esac
50	  fi
51	
52	  if [[ -e /run/openrc/softlevel ]]; then
53	    printf 'openrc'
54	    return 0
55	  fi
56	  if [[ -e /run/systemd/system ]]; then
57	    printf 'systemd'
58	    return 0
59	  fi
60	  if binary_exists rc-service && binary_exists rc-update && ! binary_exists systemctl; then
61	    printf 'openrc'
62	    return 0
63	  fi
64	  if binary_exists systemctl; then
65	    printf 'systemd'
66	    return 0
67	  fi
68	  if binary_exists rc-service && binary_exists rc-update; then
69	    printf 'openrc'
70	    return 0
71	  fi
72	
73	  die "could not detect a supported service manager; set LUNARWING_SERVICE_MANAGER=systemd or openrc"
74	}

76	ensure_log_file() {
77	  touch "$WATCHDOG_LOG"
78	  chown root:root "$WATCHDOG_LOG"
79	  chmod 0644 "$WATCHDOG_LOG"
80	}
81	
82	cleanup_legacy_names() {
83	  if binary_exists systemctl; then

96	  cleanup_openrc_fcron_entry

101	    systemctl disable --now lunarwing-watchdog.timer >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

121	strip_managed_block() {
122	  local start_marker="$1"
123	  local end_marker="$2"
124	  awk -v start="$start_marker" -v end="$end_marker" '
125	    $0 == start { skip = 1; next }
126	    $0 == end { skip = 0; next }
127	    !skip { print }
128	  '
129	}

131	read_fcron_root_tab() {
132	  if ! binary_exists fcrontab; then
133	    return 1
134	  fi
135	
136	  fcrontab -l root 2>/dev/null || true
137	}
138	
139	cleanup_openrc_fcron_entry() {
140	  local current cleaned tmp
141	
142	  binary_exists fcrontab || return 0
143	
144	  current="$(read_fcron_root_tab)"
145	  cleaned="$(
146	    printf '%s\n' "$current" \
147	      | strip_managed_block "$FCRON_MARKER_BEGIN" "$FCRON_MARKER_END" \
148	      | strip_managed_block "$LEGACY_FCRON_MARKER_BEGIN" "$LEGACY_FCRON_MARKER_END"
149	  )"
150	
151	  if [[ "$cleaned" == "$current" ]]; then
152	    return 0
153	  fi
154	
155	  tmp="$(mktemp)"
156	  trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' RETURN
157	  if [[ -n "$cleaned" ]]; then
158	    printf '%s\n' "$cleaned" >"$tmp"
159	  else
160	    : >"$tmp"
161	  fi
162	  fcrontab "$tmp" root
163	  rm -f "$tmp"
164	  trap - RETURN
165	}

167	install_openrc_fcron_entry() {
168	  local current cleaned tmp
169	
170	  binary_exists fcrontab || die "fcron mode requires the fcrontab command"
171	
172	  current="$(read_fcron_root_tab)"
173	  cleaned="$(
174	    printf '%s\n' "$current" \
175	      | strip_managed_block "$FCRON_MARKER_BEGIN" "$FCRON_MARKER_END" \
176	      | strip_managed_block "$LEGACY_FCRON_MARKER_BEGIN" "$LEGACY_FCRON_MARKER_END"
177	  )"
178	
179	  tmp="$(mktemp)"
180	  trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' RETURN
181	  if [[ -n "$cleaned" ]]; then
182	    printf '%s\n' "$cleaned" >"$tmp"
183	    printf '\n' >>"$tmp"
184	  else
185	    : >"$tmp"
186	  fi
187	
188	  {
189	    printf '%s\n' "$FCRON_MARKER_BEGIN"
190	    printf '%%hourly %s\n' "$OPENRC_WRAPPER"
191	    printf '%s\n' "$FCRON_MARKER_END"
192	  } >>"$tmp"
193	
194	  fcrontab "$tmp" root
195	  rm -f "$tmp"
196	  trap - RETURN
197	}

199	openrc_scheduler_dir() {
200	  if [[ -n "${LUNARWING_WATCHDOG_CRON_DIR:-}" ]]; then
201	    printf '%s' "$LUNARWING_WATCHDOG_CRON_DIR"
202	    return 0
203	  fi
204	  if [[ -d /etc/cron.hourly ]]; then
205	    printf '%s' "/etc/cron.hourly"
206	    return 0
207	  fi
208	  if [[ -d /etc/periodic/hourly ]]; then
209	    printf '%s' "/etc/periodic/hourly"
210	    return 0
211	  fi

213	  die "OpenRC watchdog install needs /etc/cron.hourly or /etc/periodic/hourly; set LUNARWING_WATCHDOG_CRON_DIR to override"
214	}

216	openrc_has_fcron() {
217	  binary_exists fcrontab || [[ -x /etc/init.d/fcron ]]
218	}
219	
220	openrc_fcron_service_exists() {
221	  [[ -x /etc/init.d/fcron ]]
222	}

224	openrc_scheduler_service() {
225	  local service
226	  for service in cronie crond dcron; do
227	    if [[ -x "/etc/init.d/${service}" ]]; then
228	      printf '%s' "$service"
229	      return 0
230	    fi
231	  done
232	  return 1
233	}

235	detect_openrc_scheduler_mode() {
236	  local override="${LUNARWING_WATCHDOG_SCHEDULER:-auto}"
237	  override="${override,,}"
238	
239	  case "$override" in
240	    ""|auto)
241	      if openrc_scheduler_service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
242	        printf '%s' "hourly"
243	        return 0
244	      fi
245	      if openrc_has_fcron; then
246	        printf '%s' "fcron"
247	        return 0
248	      fi
249	      printf '%s' "hourly"
250	      return 0
251	      ;;
252	    hourly|cron-hourly|periodic-hourly)
253	      printf '%s' "hourly"
254	      return 0
255	      ;;
256	    fcron)
257	      openrc_has_fcron || die "LUNARWING_WATCHDOG_SCHEDULER=fcron requires fcron/fcrontab to be installed"
258	      printf '%s' "fcron"
259	      return 0
260	      ;;
261	    *)
262	      die "unsupported OpenRC watchdog scheduler '$override'; use auto, hourly, or fcron"
263	      ;;
264	  esac
265	}

267	install_openrc_confd() {
268	  if [[ -f "$OPENRC_CONFD" ]]; then
269	    chmod 0644 "$OPENRC_CONFD"
270	    say "Preserved existing OpenRC watchdog config: $OPENRC_CONFD"
271	    return 0
272	  fi
273	
274	  install -o root -g root -m 0644 \
275	    "${REPO_ROOT}/systemd/lunarwing-watchdog.confd" \
276	    "$OPENRC_CONFD"
277	  say "Installed OpenRC watchdog config: $OPENRC_CONFD"

281	  cleanup_systemd_watchdog
282	  cleanup_openrc_watchdog
283	  cleanup_openrc_fcron_entry
284	
285	  install -o root -g root -m 0755 \
286	    "${REPO_ROOT}/scripts/lunarwing-watchdog.sh" \
287	    "$SYSTEMD_WRAPPER"
288	
289	  install -o root -g root -m 0644 \
290	    "${REPO_ROOT}/systemd/lunarwing-watchdog.service" \
291	    "${SYSTEMD_UNIT_DIR}/lunarwing-watchdog.service"
292	
293	  install -o root -g root -m 0644 \
294	    "${REPO_ROOT}/systemd/lunarwing-watchdog.timer" \
295	    "${SYSTEMD_UNIT_DIR}/lunarwing-watchdog.timer"
296	
297	  ensure_log_file
298	
299	  systemctl daemon-reload
300	  systemctl enable --now lunarwing-watchdog.timer
301	  systemctl start lunarwing-watchdog.service
302	
303	  say "Installed systemd watchdog timer."
304	  systemctl status lunarwing-watchdog.timer --no-pager
305	}
306	
307	install_openrc_watchdog() {
308	  local schedule_mode scheduler_dir scheduler_hook scheduler_service
309	  schedule_mode="$(detect_openrc_scheduler_mode)"
310	
311	  cleanup_systemd_watchdog
312	  cleanup_openrc_watchdog
313	  cleanup_openrc_fcron_entry

316	    "${REPO_ROOT}/scripts/lunarwing-watchdog-openrc.sh" \
317	    "$OPENRC_WRAPPER"

321	  ensure_log_file

323	  if [[ "$schedule_mode" == "fcron" ]]; then

325	
326	    if openrc_fcron_service_exists; then
327	      rc-update add fcron default >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
328	      rc-service fcron start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
329	      say "Installed OpenRC watchdog fcron entry for root."
330	      say "Scheduler service: fcron"
331	    else
332	      say "Installed OpenRC watchdog fcron entry for root."
333	      say "No OpenRC fcron init script detected automatically. Start fcron manually."
334	    fi
335	
336	    say "Schedule mode: fcron"
337	    say "Auto mode only selects fcron when no cronie/crond/dcron hourly scheduler is already present."
338	  else
339	    scheduler_dir="$(openrc_scheduler_dir)"
340	    scheduler_hook="${scheduler_dir}/lunarwing-watchdog"
341	
342	    install -o root -g root -m 0755 \
343	      "${REPO_ROOT}/systemd/lunarwing-watchdog.cron.hourly" \
344	      "$scheduler_hook"
345	
346	    if scheduler_service="$(openrc_scheduler_service)"; then
347	      rc-update add "$scheduler_service" default >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
348	      rc-service "$scheduler_service" start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
349	      say "Installed OpenRC watchdog scheduler hook: $scheduler_hook"
350	      say "Scheduler service: $scheduler_service"
351	    else

353	      say "No known hourly scheduler service detected automatically. Start your cron daemon manually."
354	    fi
355	
356	    if [[ "$scheduler_dir" == "/etc/cron.hourly" ]]; then
357	      say "Schedule mode: cron.hourly"
358	    elif [[ "$scheduler_dir" == "/etc/periodic/hourly" ]]; then

364	    say "Note: unlike the systemd timer, plain cron-style schedules do not replay missed runs after downtime."
365	    return 0
366	  fi
367	
368	  say "Unlike the plain cron-hourly path, fcron can provide better catch-up behavior depending on your fcron policy."
369	}

109	detect_init_system() {
110	  local override="${LUNARWING_SERVICE_MANAGER:-}"
111	  if [[ -n "$override" ]]; then
112	    case "${override,,}" in
113	      systemd|systemd-user) printf 'systemd'; return 0 ;;
114	      openrc)               printf 'openrc';  return 0 ;;
115	      *) die "unsupported service manager override '$override'; use systemd or openrc" ;;
116	    esac
117	  fi
118	
119	  if [[ -e /run/openrc/softlevel ]]; then printf 'openrc'; return 0; fi
120	  if [[ -e /run/systemd/system ]];   then printf 'systemd'; return 0; fi
121	
122	  if command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
123	    printf 'openrc'; return 0
124	  fi
125	  if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'systemd'; return 0; fi
126	  if command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'openrc'; return 0; fi
127	
128	  die "could not detect a supported service manager; set LUNARWING_SERVICE_MANAGER=systemd or openrc"
129	}

131	INIT_SYSTEM=""
132	ensure_init_system() {
133	  [[ -n "$INIT_SYSTEM" ]] || INIT_SYSTEM="$(detect_init_system)"

138	detect_container_runtime() {
139	  local override="${LUNARWING_CONTAINER_RUNTIME:-}"
140	  if [[ -n "$override" ]]; then
141	    case "${override,,}" in
142	      docker|podman) printf '%s' "${override,,}"; return 0 ;;
143	      *) die "unsupported container runtime '$override'; use docker or podman" ;;
144	    esac
145	  fi
146	
147	  if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
148	    printf 'podman'; return 0
149	  fi
150	  if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'docker'; return 0; fi
151	  if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'podman'; return 0; fi
152	
153	  die "neither docker nor podman found; install one or set LUNARWING_CONTAINER_RUNTIME"
154	}

163	ports_registry_init() {
164	  if [[ ! -d /etc/lunarwing ]]; then
165	    mkdir -p /etc/lunarwing
166	    chmod 0755 /etc/lunarwing
167	  fi
168	
169	  if [[ ! -f "$PORTS_REGISTRY" ]]; then
170	    local tmp
171	    tmp="$(mktemp "$PORTS_REGISTRY.tmp.XXXXXX")"
172	    cat >"$tmp" <<'ENDJSON'
173	{
174	  "version": 1,
175	  "range": { "start": 10000, "end": 19999 },
176	  "block_size": 10,
177	  "tenants": {}
178	}
179	ENDJSON
180	    chmod 0644 "$tmp"
181	    mv "$tmp" "$PORTS_REGISTRY"
182	    say "initialized port registry: $PORTS_REGISTRY"
183	  fi
184	}

186	ports_allocate() {
187	  local name="$1"
188	  require_cmd jq
189	
190	  if jq -e ".tenants[\"$name\"]" "$PORTS_REGISTRY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
191	    die "tenant '$name' already has ports allocated"
192	  fi
193	
194	  local base=-1
195	  local p
196	  for ((p = PORT_RANGE_START; p <= PORT_RANGE_END - PORT_BLOCK_SIZE + 1; p += PORT_BLOCK_SIZE)); do
197	    if ! jq -e ".tenants | to_entries[] | select(.value.base_port == $p)" "$PORTS_REGISTRY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
198	      base=$p
199	      break
200	    fi
201	  done
202	
203	  [[ $base -ge 0 ]] || die "no free port blocks in range $PORT_RANGE_START-$PORT_RANGE_END"
204	
205	  local tmp
206	  tmp="$(mktemp "$PORTS_REGISTRY.tmp.XXXXXX")"
207	  jq --arg name "$name" --argjson base "$base" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
208	    .tenants[$name] = {
209	      base_port: $base,
210	      user: $name,
211	      created_at: $ts,
212	      ports: {
213	        gateway:    ($base + 0),
214	        http:       ($base + 1),
215	        bridge:     ($base + 2),
216	        postgres:   ($base + 3),
217	        proxy:      ($base + 4),
218	        weechat:    ($base + 5),
219	        reserved_0: ($base + 6),
220	        reserved_1: ($base + 7),
221	        reserved_2: ($base + 8),
222	        reserved_3: ($base + 9)
223	      }
224	    }
225	  ' "$PORTS_REGISTRY" >"$tmp"
226	  chmod 0644 "$tmp"
227	  mv "$tmp" "$PORTS_REGISTRY"
228	
229	  say "allocated port block $base-$((base + PORT_BLOCK_SIZE - 1)) for tenant '$name'"
230	  printf '%s' "$base"
231	}
